scope.purpose: Predeclare development-readiness and future independent-holdout qualification semantics before any fresh holdout access.

matchingRule.name: one_to_one_ordered_five_line_half_spacing
matchingRule.assignment: Greedy one-to-one minimum normalized mean line-Y error among eligible pairs. All five ordered predicted line centers must lie within the tolerance and the predicted/teacher horizontal bboxes must overlap.
matchingRule.compatibilityRequirement: The scoring implementation used for qualification must reproduce the frozen v1 development diagnostic of 71/197 matches before it is permitted to score a fresh holdout.

metricSemantics.teacherSystemRecallAtHalfSpacing: matched teacher systems divided by all unambiguous teacher-confirmed standard five-line systems
metricSemantics.predictedSystemPrecisionAtHalfSpacing: matched predicted systems divided by all predicted systems
metricSemantics.presentPageCoverage: staff-present pages with at least one source-supported standard five-line prediction divided by staff-present pages
metricSemantics.absentPageSpecificity: staff-absent pages with zero predicted staff systems divided by staff-absent pages
metricSemantics.fiveLineCountCorrectRate: accepted predicted staff systems containing exactly five ordered line records divided by accepted predicted staff systems
metricSemantics.lineOrderCorrectRate: accepted predicted staff systems whose five center-Y values are strictly increasing divided by accepted predicted staff systems
metricSemantics.tabSixLineRejectionRate: designated six-line/TAB-like negative controls not promoted to a standard five-line staff system divided by such controls
metricSemantics.byteRepeatDeterminism: two executions on identical source bytes, config and detector source produce byte-identical canonical raw JSON

developmentReadinessForFutureHoldoutRequ.rationale: These are readiness floors for deciding whether spending a new independent holdout is defensible. They intentionally mirror the predeclared development objectives but do not qualify staff_line and do not authorize holdout access by themselves.

rationale.recall: The independent holdout must demonstrate materially broader source coverage than the development-readiness floor rather than merely repeat it.
rationale.precision: A preservation reference must keep false staff topology low; 0.80 is stricter than the development readiness floor and approximately preserves the precision regime already observed in v1/v1.1.
rationale.presentPageCoverage: Qualification may tolerate an isolated safe abstention but not systematic page-level collapse.
rationale.absentPageSpecificity: Hallucinating staff topology on staff-absent material is a safety failure, so the required rate is exact.
rationale.fiveLineAndOrder: A prediction cannot count as a standard staff system unless its topology is exactly five ordered lines.
rationale.tabRejection: Promoting six-line/TAB-like lanes into five-line staff topology is a semantic category error and is therefore an exact rejection gate.
rationale.determinismAndIdentity: Qualification evidence must be reproducible and bound to exact source bytes.

evidenceBindingRequired: detector module path and detector source SHA-256
canonical detector config and config SHA-256
exact source inventory with per-page SHA-256
canonical raw source-only output and SHA-256 sidecar
teacher/holdout truth artifact identity and SHA-256
